items.title: Dorothy Donegan — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I like to work on the Rachmaninoff Third Concerto.

ctx.x: Can you tell me something—when you’re really, really down, which one of these do you prefer to play?
I like to work on the Rachmaninoff Third Concerto.
When you’re really down? What does it do for you?
